name: self assisted inverse leg curl (on floor)
description: Kneeling with your heels anchored, you lower your body forward under hamstring control and use your hands to help you back up. Uses only your body weight.
instructions: Kneel on a mat and hook your heels under a bench or other sturdy support behind you.
Keep your body straight from knees to head, hands at your chest.
Lean forward slowly, resisting with your hamstrings.
Catch yourself with your hands when you can no longer hold the descent.
Push off lightly with your hands and pull yourself back up with your hamstrings.
